name: tab_ext
description: ブラウザをまたいだタブ共有を行う拡張機能

scripts.build:chrome: npm run clean && node scripts/build-manifest.mjs chrome && node scripts/copy-static.mjs chrome
scripts.build:firefox: npm run clean && node scripts/build-manifest.mjs firefox && node scripts/copy-static.mjs firefox
scripts.dev:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.build:xpi: npm run build:firefox && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir dist/firefox-artifacts
